recipient_is_blacklisted.meaning: the mint recipient address of the cross-chain message is blacklisted
recipient_is_blacklisted.checkpoint: before lzReceive processing of the arriving message

cross_chain_message_arrived.meaning: a LayerZero cross-chain message has arrived at the Spoke chain to mint tokens to a user
cross_chain_message_arrived.checkpoint: before lzReceive processing of the arriving message

lzreceive_reverted.meaning: the lzReceive transaction for the arriving mint message reverted
lzreceive_reverted.checkpoint: after lzReceive execution of the arriving message

claims.scope: LayerZero cross-chain message delivery minting iTryTokenOFT tokens on the Spoke chain (MegaETH)

preconditions.text: The recipient address of the cross-chain mint is blacklisted.; A cross-chain message arrives via LayerZero to mint tokens to a user on the Spoke chain.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: A blacklisted recipient of a bridge mint should not cause the LayerZero message execution to revert in a way that blocks processing of subsequent higher-nonce messages for other users.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The lzReceive transaction reverts when the mint recipient is blacklisted.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The arriving cross-chain message is a mint to the blacklisted recipient on the Spoke chain.
The blacklisted recipient is the 'to' address of the bridge-triggered mint.

limitations: Formalizes only the direct lzReceive revert impact; channel blocking and bridge DoS are separate impacts not covered here.
The report notes admin un-blacklisting as a possible exception to permanence; not part of this claim.
